what: The parrot page's flow of sounds as symbols, measured 2026-11-15: the starting memory's build, the page's headless checks (tests/test_sound_symbols.py) and offline readings on the page's own host code.

presets.note: the twelve preset questions, two rounds, a pistachio after each right answer. The times of this run were taken with the machine's load between 20 and 220 from other work; on a quiet machine (load 3) words lit a median 212 ms after their start (p90 288, max 327) and answers began a median 658 ms after the question's end (max 896)

first_visit.step: the switch, the question list, Ask, Pistachio and the microphone button are on screen
Listen to me pressed: the question list goes, the parrot looks at you
a word said: the ear's sign lights while it is said; it is kept as one utterance and said back
Curious pressed: the question list is back
a question asked: its words as a subtitle, the parrot's turn shown, the answer by the parrot
first_visit.subtitle: What is this?

first_visit.step: a pistachio: the dopamine box lights, the lesson is taken

mic_refused.told: The microphone did not start: Not supported.

visitors_never_heard_offline.note: four voices in no record (a British man, an Australian man, an Indian woman, an American woman), their clean takes as the ear hears them, nothing written: B the meaning each take is taken for; C after one pistachio on that visitor's first take of the utterance. With the woman's records alone B read 65 right of 160.

one_answer_paid_twelve_times.amount_.05: the cup's colour turns red after 4 pistachios for the apple's red, and stays
one_answer_paid_twelve_times.with_the_surprise_rule: no weight moves; six probe answers right after every pistachio
